mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE user_type = '00') AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE user_type = '01') AS totalCreators, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_work WHERE is_deleted = 0) AS totalWorks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_work WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'pending') AS pendingWorks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_work WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'on_shelf') AS onShelfWorks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_work WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'approved') AS approvedWorks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayNewUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_work WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()) AS todayNewWorks

SELECT t.d AS statDate, IFNULL(u.cnt, 0) AS newUsers, IFNULL(w.cnt, 0) AS newWorks FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) AS d FROM ( SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 ) nums WHERE n < #{days} ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) d, COUNT(*) cnt FROM sys_user GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) u ON u.d = t.d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(created_at) d, COUNT(*) cnt FROM sys_work WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ) w ON w.d = t.d ORDER BY t.d ASC

SELECT w.author_id AS userId, IFNULL(u.nick_name, CONCAT('user-', w.author_id)) AS nickname, COUNT(*) AS publishedCount, SUM(w.view_count) AS totalViews, SUM(w.favorite_count) AS totalFavorites FROM sys_work w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = w.author_id WHERE w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.status = 'on_shelf' GROUP BY w.author_id, u.nick_name ORDER BY totalViews DESC LIMIT #{limit}
